scenario.name: r-rc-1-threshold-reject
scenario.description: request_compaction structured context-guard reject via disposable session (measured below threshold, or unmeasured with a live cause), with no compaction after it

expectedReceipts.name: tool-registered
expectedReceipts.description: Direct tools.effective inventory contains request_compaction for the disposable session

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoked
expectedReceipts.description: The current row nonce appears in a typed request_compaction invocation with a correlation ID

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-rejected
expectedReceipts.description: Authoritative request_compaction toolResult is bound by toolCallId to this row's nonce-bearing invocation and returned status=rejected with guard=context_threshold measured below the floor (contextUsage and threshold both present, contextUsage < threshold) or guard=context_unmeasured with a live cause (no_fresh_usage | unknown_context_window); never inventory-only wording, and never an inventory_only cause whatever the guard

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) holding the row’s request_compaction tool-execution span, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: tool-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: tool-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace on this seat inside the row’s evidence window, holding one request_compaction tool-execution span.

review.notes: Threshold Reject. Validates direct typed-tool registration, this row's nonce-bearing invocation, the matching structured toolResult rejection, and that no compaction follows it. Safe to run: mutates=false. Assistant sentinel prose cannot satisfy this synchronous reject row, and the Tempo trace is never its verdict authority. Since #600 the trace is review-completeness debt: tempo-trace-json and tool-trace-correlation are required receipts, so a missing trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its verdict.

census.limits: request_compaction is tool-only and has no token form. The census found no span records whether a request was accepted or refused, so the accept/refuse distinction that is this row’s whole claim exists only in the structured toolResult. The trace receipt can show only that one request_compaction tool span ran on this seat in the row’s window; it records review completeness, never the verdict.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed request_compaction executions are visible but carry no accepted/rejected outcome.

attributes.notes: Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The trace is published as a public-safe Tempo projection of the tool-execution span. Prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: tools.effective lists request_compaction, this row’s nonce-bearing typed invocation is observed, its toolResult returns status=rejected with guard=context_threshold measured below the floor or guard=context_unmeasured with a live cause, and no transcript compaction row or compaction signal follows it within the side-effect window after the turn ends.
controls.negative: Assistant prose cannot pass the row, and a trace alone can neither satisfy nor block its verdict. Nor can context_threshold without both numbers or at or above its threshold, inventory-only wording or an inventory_only cause under any guard, an unmeasured rejection without a live cause or carrying usage numbers, or a rejection followed by a compaction, which is FAIL-candidate.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: The nonce-bound request_compaction toolResult returns a structured rejection with no compaction side effect: either guard=context_threshold (measured below the floor: contextUsage and threshold both numbers, contextUsage < threshold) or guard=context_unmeasured with a live cause (no_fresh_usage | unknown_context_window) and no usage numbers. An unmeasured rejection never counts as measured below-threshold proof. Inventory-only wording under either guard, or an inventory_only cause whatever the guard and whatever numbers come with it, on the live seat is non-PASS. No compaction side effect is observed, never assumed, and the claim is bounded by its window: no transcript compaction row new since the sessions.get read before dispatch when the transcript is read again 240s after the turn ends (the product's 180s compaction timeout plus a 60s scheduling margin; OPENCLAW_RRC1_SIDE_EFFECT_WINDOW_MS may lengthen that window, never shorten it), and no compaction signal on the subscribed stream after dispatch. At openclaw 542d1cac46 the 180s is a silence timeout that summary progress re-arms, up to ten windows, and agents.defaults.compaction.timeoutSeconds can change it, so a compaction still streaming its summary, or one on a seat with a longer timeout, can commit after the window: the PASS says no compaction committed within it. A window that does not complete, or is shorter than 240s, leaves the claim unproven, which is non-PASS. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Registration, invocation, or a structured rejection that meets the PASS rule is missing; or no compaction side effect is unproven, because the window did not complete or is shorter than the contract's; or the run saw compaction evidence that does not show a committed compaction after the rejection in this session: a compaction start or an end with completed:false (an attempt), a transcript compaction row before the toolResult or in a read without it, a stream signal that names no session or arrived before the toolResult, a stream compaction row the baseline already held, or evidence whose counts and observations disagree. A compaction after a rejection that breaks the PASS rule stays PARTIAL on that rule, and verdict_reason names the compaction too. verdict_reason names the first missing piece. A missing trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Contract change from the review of docs 3e2c83c7 (karmaterminal/openclaw#1506): FAIL-candidate when registration, dispatch and the nonce-bound toolResult are present, the toolResult is a rejection that meets the PASS rule, and a committed compaction is observed after the rejection in this session: a transcript compaction row after the nonce-bound toolResult in the same sessions.get read, or, naming this session and arriving after the toolResult, a compaction row on the subscribed stream that the baseline did not hold or an agent compaction end with completed:true. A compaction start, or an end with completed:false, is an attempt, not a committed compaction. A committed compaction contradicts the rejection, so it is FAIL even if the run stops before the window ends. The evidence carries it, and must agree with itself: side_effect.compaction_observations (source, record id, phase and completed, the read, session_named, after_rejection) and the stream and transcript counts in verdict_reason. An incomplete observation stays PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-rc-1-threshold-reject.js invokes request_compaction in a disposable session and reads the toolResult.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review can confirm the tool span; it carries no outcome.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live request_compaction reject row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Requires direct tools.effective registration, this row's nonce-bearing typed invocation, and the matching authoritative role=toolResult rejection: guard=context_threshold measured below the floor (contextUsage < threshold) or guard=context_unmeasured with its live cause, and no compaction side effect. The side effect is a bounded observation: sessions.get before dispatch and again 240s after the turn ends (the product's 180s compaction timeout plus a 60s scheduling margin; OPENCLAW_RRC1_SIDE_EFFECT_WINDOW_MS may lengthen that window, never shorten it, up to 600s) shows no new transcript compaction row, and the subscribed stream carries no compaction signal; an incomplete window is unproven and PARTIAL. A committed compaction shown after the rejection in this session is FAIL-candidate, carried in side_effect.compaction_observations; a compaction attempt or an unordered signal blocks PASS and the window still runs. The turn ends at this session's lifecycle end for the acknowledged send run, or at a reply row after the toolResult, and the final read counts only while it still holds the nonce-bound toolResult. At openclaw 542d1cac46 that transcript row, written when a compaction commits, is the only operator-visible mark of a volitional compaction, and the 180s is a silence timeout that summary progress re-arms, so a compaction still streaming its summary can commit after the window. timeoutSeconds (350) covers the scenario's default k6 maxDuration of 320s plus k6's default 30s gracefulStop; a lengthened window lengthens maxDuration with it. The folded evidence names the guard, the cause and the window. Inventory-only wording, or an inventory_only cause whatever the guard, on the live seat is non-PASS. Assistant prose cannot pass the row. The verdict needs no Tempo trace, but review completeness does (#600): tempo-trace-json and tool-trace-correlation stay pending until the collector attributes the request_compaction tool span.
